name: APERTURE Catalogue-Grounded 200

journey_policy.surface_language: Committed journeys are the canonical semantic layer; the full runner may apply the checked-in DeepSeek surface realizer without changing hidden state.

evaluation.target_boundary: The evaluator owns target_parent_asin; reset/respond receive only profile, shopper message, turn number, and top_k.
evaluation.recall_at_10: Fraction of journeys whose target appears in the Top-10 after any required intent override.
evaluation.turns_to_recall: Mean first-hit turn among recalled journeys.
evaluation.exploration_satisfaction: Mean pre-disclosure slate score: 60% grounded relevance coverage plus 40% meaningful product-direction diversity.

scope_note: The target pool comes from the released 200 development products. This is a complementary representation-and-interaction benchmark, not an organizer holdout.
